2228-4279-7918.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
2228-4279-7918.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Sifa Grent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
2228-4279-7918.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

1379-1651-4659-5261-8116.description:
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting Frontline Rush without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Frontline Rush, creating two creature tokens that are also artifacts due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping both creature tokens, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing one creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped tokens, you may sacrifice any number of them to add infinite colorless mana.

522-4050--5.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Melira.
Repeat.

225-1308-2557-4772-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

3129-4365-4772-5478-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
3129-4365-4772-5478-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

3693-6919-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
3693-6919-7803.description:
Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to it.
Walking Ballista triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Brad Boimler.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
3693-6919-7803.notes: You can skip step 4 if desired.

851-2976-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
851-2976-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Animate Land
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

129-1409-6006-7730.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

1018-2103-7631.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Skullwinder
When the Skullwinder token enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1445-4871-6798-7396.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-6798-7396.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

677-4217-5211-5231.easyPrerequisites: You control at least four lands.
677-4217-5211-5231.description:
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying {1}{U/R}{U/R}.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve the copy of Brass's Bounty, creating a Treasure token for each land you control.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Lutri, adding {R}.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {G}{W}{U}{B}.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Lutri from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 3.
677-4217-5211-5231.notes: You can start the combo instead at step 7 if Lutri is in your graveyard. This changes the mana needed to {6}{W}{U}{B}{R}{R}{G}.

2533-5147-6909.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
2533-5147-6909.description:
Cast Carnage by paying {2}{B}{R}. 
When Carnage enters, it triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Carnage.
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Carnage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

775-1409-2397.description:
Activate Jewel Thief by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Jewel Thief enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Jewel Thief.
Resolve both Jewel Thief triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

1739-2908-3682-5542.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying {0}.
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding one mana.
Cast Dream Stalker by paying one mana.
When Dream Stalker enters, it triggers twice due to Delney, returning Mox Amber and Dream Stalker from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

5361-6568-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
5361-6568-7009.description:
Activate Auton Soldier using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Y'shtola Rhul triggers, blinking Auton Soldier. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

2438-5276-6767.description:
Cast Leonin Relic-Warder by paying {W}{W}.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder.
When Leonin Relic-Warder dies, its second ability triggers, returning Rescue Skiff from exile to the battlefield.
When Rescue Skiff enters, it triggers, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 3.

1850-2167-2573.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1850-2167-2573.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

1117-2866-3375-6518.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2457-4289-4927-6753.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

856-1808-2034-4231.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, adding {C}{C}.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Eloise's first ability triggers, creating a Clue, Food and Treasure token.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Eloise's second ability triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

957-1987-2493-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
957-1987-2493-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Archaeomancer.
When Archaeomancer and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Stretch from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Stretch during your draw step.
Repeat.

4871-5231-5544-6011.notablePrerequisites: Scavenger's Talent is at least level 2.
4871-5231-5544-6011.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Forsaken Miner, adding {R}.
When Forsaken Miner dies, Scavenger's Talent's second ability triggers, targeting an opponent, and Pitiless Plunderer triggers.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Scavenger's Talent trigger, causing an opponent to mill two cards.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1479-2783-4826-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-2783-4826-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Nesting Dragon trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Nesting Dragon triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Nesting Dragon triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

3519-4115-4443.notablePrerequisites: You do not control an Illusion or have an Illusion creature card in your graveyard.
3519-4115-4443.description:
Cast Riftwing Cloudskate by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Volo triggers, copying the Riftwing Cloudskate spell.
Resolve the copy of the Riftwing Cloudskate spell.
When the Riftwing Cloudskate token enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting itself.
Holding priority, activate Food Chain by exiling the Riftwing Cloudskate token, adding six {U} that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
The Riftwing Cloudskate trigger from step 4 fizzles due to having no legal target.
Resolve the original Riftwing Cloudskate spell.
When Riftwing Cloudskate enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

662-2043-2320-2493.notablePrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {6}{U}{U}.
662-2043-2320-2493.description:
During an opponent's turn, after their upkeep step, activate Liquimetal Coating by tapping it, causing Archaeomancer to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {6}{U}{U}.
Cast Reset by paying {U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Archaeomancer that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
When the Archaeomancer token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Reset to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2.
If lands you control can tap to proudce at least {7}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, which can be used to activate Urza's ability infinitely and/or cast Reset choosing its other modes.

1737-2119-2544-4893.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {0} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Seat of the Synod.
Activate the Seat of the Synod token by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {U}, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.

1961-4067-4680-4798.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact.
1961-4067-4680-4798.description:
Activate Throne of Geth by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact, causing you to proliferate.
Venser triggers, holding priority, activate Mind over Matter by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil, untapping Throne of Geth.
Resolve the Venser trigger, creating a legendary 3/3 The Hollow Sentinel artifact creature token.
The Hollow Sentinel enters the battlefield, triggering Ovalchase Daredevil, returning Ovalchase Daredevil from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2341-4110.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
2341-4110.description:
Activate Gideon's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it.
Holding priority, activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Gideon's ability.
Resolve the copy of Gideon's ability, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-3433-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Hornet Queen.
When Hornet Queen enters the battlefield, it triggers itself and Emiel the Blessed.
Resolve Emiel the Blessed's ability, choosing not to pay for it.
Resolve Hornet Queen's ability, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens with deathtouch.
When the Insects enter the battlefield, Emiel the Blessed triggers four times; choose not to pay for its ability.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Insect tokens, adding {4}.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite colorless mana, you may activate Emiel the Blessed any number of times.
